name: shoot-em-all
description: Browser tactical FPS inspired by Counter-Strike 1.6. Procedural de_dust2, authoritative 30Hz server.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix client && npm start --prefix server
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
